csv_scope_of_work: The Affordable Housing Opportunities Matter (AHOM), a NJ Non-Profit, is soliciting Quotes from qualified Architecture & Engineering firms (A&E) or individuals to provide A&E services in connection with housing development in the Town of Boonton, New Jersey that AHOM manages and operates through a Management Agreement with the Housing Authority of the Town of Boonton. The successful proposer will be licensed by the State of New Jersey and will have the appropriate academic qualifications in Architecture and/or Engineering. This is a Project Specific Proposal.
